description: List the grid profiles (the templates of the app's Tables page). A template is a prompt plus answer columns: id, name, the template's prompt (field system_prompt; it is the instruction asked of every row), output format (plain text, or JSON whose fields become the answer columns: mode object = one answer per row, array = several entries per row). Pick one as grid_profile_id for run_grid.
name: list_grid_profiles
